vb_textbox.text: I noticed that the gnomes seemed to work in pairs. When the green gnome was collecting more mushrooms the brown one would too, this is the same for the purple and pink gnomes. This would last for around 20 rounds. Once you notice that the pair of gnomes are collecting less, switch to the other pair ( after a sequence of 4 low collection rates). I feel like one pair (brown and green) gave a larger yield overall.
